items.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
items.why: Quote states personal V2 API token auth only; oauth2 not mentioned.
Gives OAuth authorize URL, related to oauth2 but not sufficient alone.

items.quote: The HTTP verb in your request should be POST, and the token URL is `https://auth.monday.com/oauth2/token`.
items.why: Gives POST token URL, consistent with oauth2 flow but not sufficient alone.

items.quote: If you don't have a monday.com account yet, create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.
items.why: Quote directly says free developer account yields API token for testing.

items.quote: Our API uses the following endpoint: `https://api.monday.com/v2`.
items.why: Quote gives the endpoint only; GraphQL, schema path and breadth not stated.

items.quote: Our GraphQL schema defines the structure of the available API data and contains all of the available queries and mutations.
items.why: Says schema holds queries and mutations; no endpoint or breadth claim.

items.quote: You can also use the MCP server to build your own AI agents or integrate AI features into your apps.
items.why: Implies a vendor MCP server exists; no GitHub URL or official status stated.
